label: MOTION_1, moving and being moved: To move is nothing other than to educe something from potency to…
definition: To move is nothing other than to educe something from potency to act. `MovedIn x r`: x is being reduced from potency to act in respect r; `MovesIn y x r`: y so reduces x. Read at one time (simul): a present series of movers, not a history. Nothing restricts it to local motion or to bodies. Aristotle's definition of motion as the actuality of the potential as such, read for beings and respects (STMT-BEING-MOVED-IS-ACTUALIZATION-OF-POTENCY), would make STMT-NOTHING-MOVED-EXCEPT-AS-IN-POTENCY analytic if adopted as the Lean definition of `MovedIn`; it is no stronger than that premise (result ACT-POTENCY-DEFINITIONAL-ANALYSES-CONSERVATIVE), so `MovedIn` stays a parameter.
note: Lean locators: MotionModel.MovedIn : Being → Respect → Prop is the primary field for being moved, and MotionModel.MovesIn : Being → Being → Respect → Prop is the separate mover field. These are primitive parameters, not definitions that reduce one relation to the other. The source-reading premises constrain them; the intended reduction interpretation and its applicability remain OPEN.

formal_gap.meaning: MotionModel.MovedIn x r says that the being x is being moved in the respect r, where 'moved' is read broadly as being brought from potency to act in r, at one time (the present phase of a reduction, not a past history). In a MotionModel it is a supplied relation between a being and a respect; nothing in its type limits it to local motion, to bodies or to change in time. Its companion field MovesIn y x r (y so reduces x) is separate: Lean does not define either relation through the other.
examples: Wood being heated by fire, read with x the wood and r being hot (the stock example of ST I q.2 a.3).
A knower passing from not contemplating to contemplating, read with r the respect of contemplating, falls under the broad reading; it is not a local motion.
exclusions: Having been changed in the past: a finished change is not a present MovedIn edge.
Merely being in potency to r without being brought towards act (InPotency alone).

Aristotle's physical change (DEF-MOTION-AS-PHYSICAL-CHANGE) is only one kind of such reduction; DISAMB-MOTION keeps the two senses apart and restricts the typed Physics readings to physical respects (DEF-PHYSICAL-RESPECT).
The causal senses moving, causing a perfection and cause of origin are kept apart in DISAMB-CAUSE; MovedIn is the patient side of moving only.
open_obligations: The link to potency is a premise, not a law of the field: STMT-NOTHING-MOVED-EXCEPT-AS-IN-POTENCY (MovedOnlyAsInPotencyReading) constrains it, and STMT-SOMETHING-IS-MOVED-IN-THIS-WORLD supplies an instance; both are open.
That whatever is moved has a mover (ReducedOnlyByAMoverReading) and that nothing moves itself in the same respect are separate open premises; neither holds by the type of MovedIn.
Whether the intended reduction reading applies to an observed change remains OPEN.

Formalization candidate: Physics III.1's analysis (BeingMovedIsActualizationOfPotencyReading) could define MovedIn as being in potency with that potency actualized; ACT-POTENCY-DEFINITIONAL-ANALYSES-CONSERVATIVE shows this is conservative over the premise it makes analytic, so it moves the question to the new primitive ActualizedQuaPotential rather than settling it.
